title: Plugins: optional extras, secrets, code assistance and source control
summary: src/OodPlugins.cls is the host (OodPluginHost); a plugin is an ooRexx class, a subclass of OodPlugin, in its own folder, listed in plugins/index.txt, loaded only when switched on (the choice is kept in the browser). A plugin declares what it provides: diagnose, fix, assist, scm. Host calls: assist(id, task, code, context), scm(id, op, a1..a4) with ops LIST, OPEN, STATUS, COMMIT (path text message ref), HISTORY, AT; enabledFor(word). Plugins: Boston Crab (pitfall checks P1-P4, fixes for P1 and P2), Code assistance (Ask...; Anthropic through AnthropicFetchMessageClient or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint through OpenAICompatFetchTransport; proposal shown as a diff or as a Graph, Apply only when it compiles as a method body, has no :: line and passes Boston Crab), Git (GitHub REST from the page, or the git command outside a browser), Semantic Source Control (SSC MCP endpoint: source.get_package, objects_in, history, propose_edit; a commit is cut into directives and proposed per changed object). The Object Editor shares the panel (site/plugins.js).
invariants: Secrets: OodSecrets (page memory only, never saved, never shown again) -> OodSecretsProvider (plugins/common/OodBroker.cls) -> the estate SecretBroker -> a lease -> secretForTrustedConsumer. A key is never on argv, never on disk, and the page never sees a secret value.
A key is sent as an ADDRESS FETCH header from a variable for one request (HEADER name FROM var), then dropped.

A plugin that calls out names, in index.txt, the estate folders it needs on REXX_PATH (paths =); the page sets REXX_PATH when ooRexx starts, appending /usr/lib/ooRexx, because ooRexx reads REXX_PATH only then and the env replaces the default.
Assistance never changes the code itself; the user applies a proposal.
Network plugins need ADDRESS FETCH (ooRexx/WASM only): under native ooRexx they report err.noFetch and their tests say SKIP. A path is checked before a backend is made.
